profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Point Pleasant Beach, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Specialties: Web Development, Database design, PHP,,Ajax, Javascript, MySQL, MVC, SQL, CSS, XHTML, XML

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Incrementally refactored and redesigned existing monolithic applications into micro-services and stand alone front-ends.  
Integrated data from 3rd parties and clients using APIs and data feeds.
Worked closely with team members to upgrade technology stack and ensure they stayed up to date.
Mentored developers on best practices and company coding standards.
Helped migrate infrastructure from co-located physical hardware to AWS.

positions.title: Technical Program Manager
positions.locationName: Shrewsbury, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Interacted with internal and external clients to gather requirements.
Created and managed project schedules.
Wrote project plans, requirements and other relevant documentation.
Ensured that projects remained on schedule by resolving roadblocks.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: Shrewsbury, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Design and implement web applications for internal and external clients using LAMP stack.
Implement urgent client requests in a timely fashion.
Maintain and upgrade existing application suite.
Assist other developers with design and architecture decisions.
Assist in developing new process flows and implement code changes for the new processes.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Test new features of the website before released to production as well as test existing features.
Write Ruby on Rails integration tests for the new features.
Assist the lead developer with small programming needs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Design and implement small to medium scale custom web applications using Java and .Net technologies.
Maintain Windows 2003 server utilizing IIS and Tomcat.
Develop AJAX client server applications used to enrich user interface design.

positions.title: Student System Support Worker
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining backups on file and web servers running Windows Server 2003.
Maintain front-end software for our client database written in Java.
Maintain and update multiple websites using both a content management system and HTML.
Design and develop several small utility applications using C#.
Provide software and system support for the staff.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and customized vended software applications written in PHP and ASP.NET
Worked with the Princeton University Office of Development to develop web applications to assist fundraising and information management using ASP.NET (C#)
Worked with the Stewardship Department to design and develop an online form using ASP.NET, Oracle PL/SQL.
